C9000346.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 346 (Sharp singular-set bounds for stationary integral varifolds.; papers: A Codimension-One Bound for the Singular Set of a Stationary Integral Varifold; Almost-everywhere regularity of stationary integral varifolds; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_AE_MAIN.statement: AE thm:main: H^m(Sing V)=0 for every stationary integral m-varifold in Euclidean open sets, with local equality to one embedded minimal submanifold as regularity.

C_OCT_MAIN.statement: October thm:main: dim_H Sing V <= m-1 for every stationary integral m-varifold in Euclidean open sets.

C_SX_SIGNED.statement: AE sx:signed, imported verbatim as October thm:signed-input, under its printed stationary-integral, smallness, and cylinder hypotheses.

C_CONCENTRATION.statement: Verify or refute the complete shared concentration bridge: lt:config including exceptional fibers, pk:flux-moments, and pk:reverse, without changing the printed geometric hypotheses.

C_LT_CONFIG.statement: AE lt:config: a joint Q-height majority configuration has full-mass L^p distance <= C_p s sqrt(d) for p>2 with m(1/2-1/p)<1, and all-support distance <= C_beta s d^beta.

C_LOCAL_SELECTION.statement: Derive local majority selection and matching from stationary first variation, integer projection counts, and small tau, without assuming any higher height moment.

C_STOPPED_MOMENT.statement: A first-stopped-cube descent controls every support height and gives L^p bounds and quantitative small-set L^2 bounds from its scale-wise energy charges.

C_FLUX_MOMENTS.statement: AE pk:moment-dilation and pk:flux-moments follow uniformly from joint configurations, majority matching, polynomial dilation, the fixed-well barrier, and explicit Gaussian tails.

C_BAD_FLUX.statement: AE pk:bad-flux retains the full projected-mass defect, including singular pushforward mass, and is small compared with the witness flux for uniform fixed parameters.

C_REVERSE.statement: AE pk:reverse: a witness cube has the printed density range and a B^(-c_* eps_0) fraction of its excess mass on points whose every descendant has controlled density.

C_WITNESS_FLUX.statement: Upstream contact/envelope/barrier estimates and pk:witnesses supply witness tilt, transition control, polynomial dilation, and normal-flux lower bounds.

C_PACKING_CLOSURE.statement: AE pk:packing and pk:contact-charge turn controlled-density witnesses into the signed-excess induction conclusion.

C_AE_GEOMETRIC_FINISH.statement: AE centering and inward-frequency arguments upgrade signed excess to neighborhood equality with one embedded minimal submanifold.

C_OCT_GEOMETRIC_FINISH.statement: October Sections 04-07 establish prescribed-scale fitting, centered nonzero blowups, density-center retention, and dimension reduction; not certified in this bounded mission.

C_POTENTIAL.statement: AE lt:potential: the full scalar gradient equation with finite measure data gives weak-L1 control of the absolutely continuous density modulo a constant and a finite-order distributional bound.

C_PROJECTION_CORE.statement: The normal projection Jacobian and the weighted rectifiable area formula give the integer counting measure and the full measure error <= C(D+Lambda), retaining deficient-rank projected mass.

C_MONOTONICITY.statement: Stationarity and integrality imply the ambient lower mass bound omega_m*r^m at every support point, also in the stationary extension across the artificial vertical boundary when separation holds.

C_GAUSSIAN_ENDPOINT.statement: For m>2, under the literal AE local cylinder and printed fixed-well witness inputs, every measurable E satisfies integral_E G_s |V_b(z)/s|^2 dmu <= C k^(-1) delta (integral_E G_s dmu)^(2/m), uniformly in scale, k, level, and E, including exceptional projection fibers. This yields weak critical exponent 2m/(m-2), not a strong endpoint moment.

C_FINITE_HOLDER.statement: Finite weighted fourth-power Holder inequality and exponent algebra. The existing Lean kernel record certifies only this finite algebra; independent statement-fidelity review remains pending.

C_L2_OBSTRUCTION.statement: An exact nonstationary atomic model rules out an L2-only concentration argument. It does not refute any printed manuscript statement.
